title: Spotlight

subtitle.text: "Who am I supposed to hang out with?" Matt grumbled. It was the first day of rehearsals for La Bohème, and Matt wasn't happy.
Without Dede as a fellow street urchin, he had to go to Philadelphia all by himself.
Inside the theater he walked through a maze of corridors.
He came to a dead end near the costume shop. "Where is this rehearsal room anyway?"
If Dede were there, they'd be laughing about getting lost, but now Matt felt anxious.
He retraced his steps and finally found the right door.
Matt took a deep breath to calm himself and walked into a room filled with kids, all talking at once.
Mr. Lorenzo, the chorus master, gave a shrill whistle. "Okay, people, let's get started! Settle down and introduce yourselves."
One by one, the kids stood up and said their own names as well as the names of any operas they'd appeared in.
One girl had been in six operas! Matt sighed loudly, and the boy next to him leaned over.
"Not everyone has that much experience," he reassured Matt. "If you're here, you're a good singer. I'm Tim, by the way."
Following the introductions, Mr. Lorenzo welcomed the new singers.
"You'll be working with some of the best professionals in the business, and they don't have time for any nonsense.
While we'll have fun, I expect you to take your roles seriously. Now I assume you know the story of La Bohème, but for those who don't . . ."
Mr. Lorenzo said that act 1 takes place on Christmas Eve in 1830.
Four poor artists live in a garret in Paris. Because it's a holiday, they decide to eat at a café.
Rodolfo stays behind for a few minutes to finish his writing and soon hears a knock at the door.
It's Mimi, a young woman who lives in the same building; her candle has blown out and she needs a flame to relight it.
"As soon as Rodolfo and Mimi meet, they instantly fall in love," Mr. Lorenzo said.
"Love at first sight!" Matt and Tim exclaimed together, and they burst out laughing.
"Exactly!" Mr. Lorenzo said. "Do you think this romance will end happily?"
"She dies!" someone called from the back of the room.
"That's right, but not yet," Mr. Lorenzo said. "First we have to get through act 2, and that's where you come in.
The street urchins join the crowd outside the café, where the artists are dining.
We also meet Musetta, who loves Marcello, one of Rodolfo's roommates. They're always breaking up and getting back together again."
Mr. Lorenzo explained that in act 3, Marcello and Rodolfo are having trouble with their girlfriends, and by the start of act 4, both couples have broken up.

episodes.title: Now You See It, Now You Don't
